subject: CPPO Reseller Integration - entitlement mapping & escalation triage
messages:
From: Michelle Chan <michelle.chan@resellco.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aws-partner.amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps for CPPO entitlements mapping (ResellCo)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier this week. Per our conversation, ResellCo needs a clear mapping from Marketplace SKUs to our internal entitlement IDs so we can automate provisioning when the CPPO goes live. I've attached our working matrix (reseller_entitlement_matrix.xlsx).

Two asks to keep this moving:
- Can you confirm which Redwood SKU(s) will be exposed on the CPPO and the expected billing granularity (per-token vs monthly commit)?
- We have a DocuSign for the PO flow and CPI terms; would you and Ben be comfortable reviewing a draft so we can run it through legal next week? (attached ppo_docusign_draft.pdf)

Samir, looping you for any AWS CPPO-specific entitlements that need to be passed through the offer metadata.

Goal is to have the entitlement map and draft PO at a stability checkpoint by Monday so ResellCo’s engineering team can wire SSO & entitlement checks.

Thanks,
Michelle
Partnerships Lead | ResellCo
Attachment: reseller_entitlement_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
Attachment: ppo_docusign_draft.pdf (pdf, 210KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Michelle Chan <michelle.chan@resellco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@aws-partner.amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for CPPO entitlements mapping (ResellCo)

Michelle —

Thanks, received and reviewed the matrix at a high level. Quick answers:
- We'll expose two SKUs: REDWOOD-INFERENCE-GENERATE (metered per-token) and REDWOOD-INFERENCE-DEDICATED (monthly commit). I flagged the columns in your sheet where SKU mapping should live (see comments).
- Ben can take point on the DocuSign PO review — Ben, can you scan the draft and call out any redlines by EOD Friday?

Operational notes / risks I see:
1) Entitlement sync cadence: ResellCo's plan shows daily pulls from our entitlement API. That should be fine, but we need a TTL for cached entitlement assertions (30s recommended) to avoid race conditions during heavy scale-up.
2) Billing reconciliation: For monthly commit SKUs we'll need an invoice mapping table (customer -> marketplace account -> internal commitment ID). Laura, can you confirm whether Marketplace subscriber IDs will appear in the usage report we push?

Milestone wise, proposal:
- Fri 6/19: Ben returns redlines on DocuSign; Laura confirms billing keys.
- Mon 6/22: Sync to lock mapping and hand off to ResellCo eng.

I'll schedule a short triage call for Monday morning; tentative invite included.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Michelle Chan <michelle.chan@resellco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@aws-partner.amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for CPPO entitlements mapping (ResellCo)

Karthik / Michelle —

Quick read of the DocuSign draft attached. High level: looks standard for CPPO flows, two small asks before we run to legal:
- Add explicit clause that marketplace subscriber IDs are the single source of truth for entitlement assignments for CPPO subscriptions (avoids drift).
- Limit the refund window to 30 days for metered SKUs (we bake into billing reconciliation).

If ResellCo is comfortable with those, I'm fine to hand to Legal next week. I've also added inline comments to ppo_docusign_draft.pdf (see notes).

Ben
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: ppo_docusign_draft_annotated.pdf (pdf, 230KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michelle Chan <michelle.chan@resellco.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@aws-partner.amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for CPPO entitlements mapping (ResellCo)

Michelle,

Confirmed: the Marketplace usage report includes the subscriber_id and marketplace_account_id fields we need for reconciliation. We'll produce a sample CSV extract for you by EOD Monday for mapping validation. A couple of operational notes:
- For monthly commits we'll push an invoice reference with each usage report row; please ensure your entitlement table accepts an invoice_ref column.
- We'll expose an API endpoint for entitlement lookups (internal name: /v1/entitlements/marketplace) with API keys scoped to the ResellCo integration. Keys will be issued once CPPO offer is fully activated.

I'll attach the sample report once ready.

Thanks,
Laura
Billing & Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Michelle Chan <michelle.chan@resellco.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aws-partner.amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2026 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for CPPO entitlements mapping (ResellCo)

Team —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the annotated PO, Ben. Quick updates from ResellCo:
- We've accepted the two SKU mappings and updated our entitlement matrix to include the invoice_ref column you mentioned. I'll upload the revised sheet to the HubSpot deal and link it here: https://hubspot.com/deal/8342
- We're OK with the two contract items Ben outlined; please route the annotated PDF to your legal when ready.
- Regarding the API keys and entitlement endpoint, can we request one staging key first and one production key after activation? That will help our engineers test the provisioning flow without touching production subscriptions.

Next steps:
- Karthik: route Ben's annotated DocuSign to Legal (targeting EOD Wed 6/24).
- Laura: share sample usage CSV by EOD Mon 6/22.
- Samir: if there are CPPO metadata fields that must be present on the offer for AWS reporting, please flag them in the thread.

I'll be on the triage call Monday at 9:00am PT.

Thanks,
Michelle
Partnerships Lead | ResellCo
